services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Are you interested in hosting an event in Penticton? Whether you are looking to host a small meeting, a birthday party or an indoor event, we have just the facility to suit your needs. Are you thinking of planning an outdoor event? For information about costs, availability and the booking process, please visit our Plan an Outdoor Event page. For information about Penticton sports fields available to book, visit the Sports Fields page. Book a room for a birthday party at the Community Centre using our online booking service. Simply click this link and search by date to see a list of the rooms

services.name: Programs & Registration
services.desc: Swim, run, jump, play and roll! Here in Penticton, you'll find recreational options for all ages and abilities. Register here for your recreational programs with the City of Penticton. Step 1: View the available programs using our online booking system. Step 2: Log on to your account to make your bookings! Visit us at the Community Centre (325 Power Street, Penticton) during regular office hours. Having trouble with your online account? Check out our Client Support Manual and watch the How to Book a Timeslot tutorial

services.name: City Tours
services.desc: Transportation projects are rolling out across the city. Visit the following pages for construction updates on the following ongoing projects. Construction is underway on Forestbrook Drive and Ontario Street. Anticipate minor delays and watch for traffic changes, including single-lane alternating or possible temporary detours. Work underway will involve installing a new multi-use pathway along Ontario Street and Forestbrook Drive, improving connections for people walking, cycling and rolling while enhancing accessibility in the neighbourhood. This pathway will connect from Eckhardt Avenue to the existing pathway that runs along Penticton Creek. The project will also include paving

services.name: Lake-to-Lake Bike Route
services.desc: Find out more about this dedicated cycling route that starts at Lakeshore Drive (along Okanagan Lake) and carries along Martin Street, throughout downtown Penticton, and along Fairview Road to Duncan Avenue. Eventually the goal for this route is for it to connect to Skaha

blurb: Rotary Park is known for the giant ‘Peach’ concession and offers spectacular views across Okanagan Lake. It features a grassy area for picnics and hosts various special events in summer. The park is popular for water sports such as paddle boarding and boating.
